subject: The 2AM mistake that changed everything
preview_text: One long-term user's gut feeling saved them. Here's what they discovered inside the app.
body_paragraphs: Two weeks ago, a user who's been with us for 68 days—just like you—sent me a message at 2AM. She said she'd been ignoring a sinking feeling for months, but finally scanned a conversation she almost deleted. The app flagged a pattern of gaslighting her ex had mastered over three years. She thanked me for giving her clarity she didn't know she needed. That message hit me hard, because it reminded me why I built this thing in the first place.

You've been with us through 68 days of scanning, questioning, and maybe even second-guessing yourself. That takes guts. I wanted to say thank you—not the generic kind, but a real one. Most people download this app, use it once, and forget. You didn't. You're part of a small group that actually digs into the patterns, the toxicity scores, the breakdowns. That's rare, and it deserves something more than a popup.

So here's the thing only long-term users like you get: starting today, you have exclusive access to our hidden 'Gut Check' feature. It's not in the app menu—you have to open any conversation scan, then long-press the toxicity score for three seconds. A secret dashboard appears with your top three red flags across all scans, ranked by frequency. No one else sees this. It's our way of saying you've earned the deepest insight we can offer.

Open Red Flag Scanner AI right now, scan a conversation—even an old one—and try the long-press. See what patterns have been hiding in plain sight. Then reply to this email and tell me what you find. I read every single one. P.S. The user from 2AM? She's now six weeks free of that relationship and says the app helped her trust her gut again. Your turn.
